nodes.name: font.rs
nodes.summary: Generic types for CSS font properties including font-feature-settings, font-variation-settings with tag-value pairs, font-style (italic/oblique), font-size-adjust, and line-height.

nodes.name: image.rs
nodes.summary: Generic types for CSS image values including gradient stops/shapes, image-set resolution-aware images, cross-fade blending, paint worklets, and line direction enumeration.

nodes.name: length.rs
nodes.summary: Generic types for CSS length and size values including LengthPercentageOrAuto, min/max-size with clamp keywords, LengthOrNumber, anchor-size() function support, and margin shorthands.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements CompletionKeyword to represent CSS min-content/max-content/fit-content/auto keywords alongside numeric values.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for generic CSS value types, re-exporting all submodules and defining foundational wrappers: NonNegative<T>, ZeroToOne<T>, ClipRect, ClipRectOrAuto, and a C++-compatible Optional<T> enum.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains C++-compatible FFI types like Optional<T> with repr(C) layout for Servo/Gecko bindings.

nodes.name: motion.rs
nodes.summary: Generic types for CSS motion path properties including offset-path with ray() angle/size functions, path SVG data references, and offset-position coordinate values.
